source_issues.issue: 日常流程先展示 git push origin main，克隆分叉仓库和 origin 指向自己的副本在之后才解释。教学代码不构成本次执行或向上游推送的授权，译文没有改写命令。
顺序图将 git pull 简化为 Local Repo → Working Directory，省略 fetch 和集成过程。图载荷按原文保留，不能在翻译中擅自修正。
Clicking Fork alone does not change an existing local origin; the later clone-your-copy command establishes that remote
Remote defined as a hosted repository copy is a beginner simplification; a configured remote name/URL is not distinguished
